subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Delhi High Court’s ruling on the ‘Right to Be Forgotten’ in November 2024 is correct?

options.text: The judgement rejected the applicability of the ‘Right to Be Forgotten’ in cases of acquittal or quashed criminal proceedings.
The Court stated that the right to privacy cannot override public interest in matrimonial cases.
The Court permitted the petitioner to approach online platforms and search engines to mask their identities
The Court ruled that the names of the couple involved in the matrimonial dispute must remain publicly accessible to ensure transparency

solution:
The Correct answer is __**The Court permitted the petitioner to approach online platforms and search engines to mask their identities**__.

• The **Delhi High Court** ruling in November 2024 dealt with the **'Right to Be Forgotten'**, a concept gaining traction globally to allow individuals to have their personal data removed from public platforms under certain conditions.
